name: ZZF burnToHolder pays BNB at a live spot quote
summary: ZZF.burnToHolder priced burned ZongZi with uniswapRouter.getAmountsOut against WBNB and had the ZongZi token pay that many BNB from its reward pool into ZZF, which receiveRewards paid to the burner. After flash-loan buys pumped the WBNB/ZongZi pair, the attacker burned ZongZi at the inflated spot quote and withdrew nearly all of the pool's BNB.
notes: setMainToken pointed ZZF's _burnToken at the ZongZi token, and setzongziHolder let ZZF pull the token's BNB; the BNB left from the ZongZi contract, so both are targets.

Loss is the BNB that left the ZongZi reward pool across both attacker transactions, fees it paid to protocol addresses included. The flash-loan buys left about 656 more WBNB in the WBNB/ZongZi pair, which is not netted; the reported ~$223k is the attacker's net profit.
